description: This file defines a custom SQL function 'TimeDiff' for use with Doctrine ORM, which calculates the difference between two datetime expressions in specified units (minutes, hours, or seconds). The class extends Doctrine's FunctionNode and provides parsing and SQL generation logic for the custom function.

classes.name: TimeDiff
classes.description: A custom Doctrine ORM function node that computes the difference between two datetime expressions in seconds, minutes, or hours based on the specified type.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the function call in DQL to extract the two datetime arguments and the type of difference (minutes or hour).

methods.name: getSql
methods.description: Generates the SQL expression to perform the datetime difference calculation based on the parsed arguments and type.
